_doc: Every credit both games show, in one place (docs/credits.md is the human document; tools/doclint.py checks that it names every source of "sim"). roll: the original game's credits roll on Quit (iaf-reborn/menu/credits_roll.gd), one entry per line; style: heading / name (Gill Sans 20 pt), role (Gill Sans Condensed 20 pt), small (Gill Sans 16 pt), gap (an empty 12 pt line), blank (an empty 20 pt line), imagery (the Terrain Imagery section from the converted imagery layers' manifests; nothing when none is converted); text: the English line; he: the Hebrew line (optional, else text). attributions: the original game's setup wizard's Attributions (iaf-reborn/setup/wizard.gd), one BBCode bullet each. sim: Modern IAF's sources (its setup wizard's Credits and the front end's Credits page): name, use (the strings key of what it is for), lines (the licence lines as each licence asks for them, the Copernicus lines verbatim).
